name: Hotel Jerome, Auberge Collection
insider_take: This legendary 1889 Victorian gem sits at the heart of Aspen's action, where silver mining barons once ruled and Hollywood royalty now plays.
whats_special: Hotel Jerome is Aspen's original luxury hotel, featuring the famous J-Bar where Hunter S. Thompson held court and locals still gather for après-ski cocktails. The hotel's Victorian architecture contrasts beautifully with modern amenities, and it's just steps from the Silver Queen Gondola and Aspen Mountain's world-class skiing.
pro_tip: Book a room facing Main Street for prime people-watching during Aspen's legendary nightlife, or request a mountain view to wake up to the Roaring Fork Valley's stunning peaks.
dont_miss: The hotel's ghost tour - Hotel Jerome is famously haunted by "The Boy in the Basement" and other spirits from its Wild West days. Also, time your visit for the annual X Games or Food & Wine Classic when the hotel becomes celebrity central.
pros: Historic Victorian landmark with authentic Aspen charm and character
Prime downtown location steps from shopping, dining, and nightlife
Luxury amenities including spa, fitness center, and fine dining
Year-round destination with ski-in access and summer activities
cons: Premium pricing reflects exclusive Aspen market positioning
Historic building may have limited room sizes in original sections
